items.label: Teleport to waypoint
items.desc: Use the menu waypoint first, otherwise the game radar waypoint. Requires the exterior world and a successful ground query. On-foot in the current beta. Occupied-vehicle teleport is planned for the next update; in-game verification pending.

items.label: Teleport to coordinates
items.desc: Use X, Y and Z coordinates with optional ground snapping. Invalid or unloaded destinations are rejected. On-foot in the current beta. Occupied-vehicle teleport is planned for the next update; in-game verification pending.

items.label: Back
items.desc: Return to the previous teleport position in this session. On-foot in the current beta. Occupied-vehicle teleport is planned for the next update; in-game verification pending.

items.label: Save current position
items.desc: Remember your current position for the current session. On-foot in the current beta. Occupied-vehicle teleport is planned for the next update; in-game verification pending.

items.label: Teleport to saved position
items.desc: Return to a saved session position. On-foot in the current beta. Occupied-vehicle teleport is planned for the next update; in-game verification pending.

items.label: Copy current coordinates
items.desc: Fill the coordinate controls with your current position. On-foot in the current beta. Occupied-vehicle teleport is planned for the next update; in-game verification pending.

items.label: Set menu waypoint
items.desc: Choose a menu waypoint; you can also right-click the world map. On-foot in the current beta. Occupied-vehicle teleport is planned for the next update; in-game verification pending.

items.label: Vehicle spawner
items.desc: Next update — not in the current download. Search the 212-model catalogue by name, model or ID and choose a class. Ordinary vehicle spawning is implemented; trains and trailers require a dedicated spawner. Live gameplay acceptance pending.
